title: Had a blast at Hercules, so glad I decided to add it to my West End s...
transcript: can't believe I wasn't gonna go see Hercules in the West End because I saw both of the US productions and uh thought it was a mess just got out of it here this is this is so much better this is so much better why did nobody tell me and don't get me wrong I think there are still changes that are going to bug die hard fans of the film like the fact that they don't include any non human animated characters unless they're monsters it's much more rooted in reality than the original animated film out of all of the Disney musicals that has done that this kind of bugged me at the least but again at this point I'm I'm used to those changes I don't necessarily love all of the new songs and I do think Disney has an issue with being able to capture the spirit of any of its villains on stage there's always something that's just a little bit off but the amount of work that they put into Hercules since the US is like in insane absolutely insane obviously of course there's the budget in just the overall design we have these incredible projections really big set pieces that help to fill out a lot of those big sequences even the lighting and the sound works a lot better on this big West End stage seems like the big fight sequence at the end work so well I also felt like Hercules is such a visually distinct movie and I was missing a lot of that from the stage version but I think the way that they've designed a lot of these projections helps to really solidify some of that so it works a lot better for me but they've also adjusted a lot to the story the motivations for the characters are a lot clearer I think structurally it works better big moments that were happening off stage in the previous version now happen on stage it's amazing what hydraulic lifts will do for just the theatricality of a piece loved how much better this worked for me with the bigger budget and of course this cast is absolutely spectacular I did get to see Bradley Gibson again who has returned to close out Hercules here who played Herc in the Paper Mill production so it's great to see him in both of those versions I loved this so much better I'm so glad they put in the work I'm sad I'm sad now that it's closing because this is such an improvement on the previous versions and I do think that somebody going into this blind is still gonna have some of those things that just don't quite work in this adaptation but I think design wise it feels much more cohesive writing wise it feels much more cohesive as far as tickets go I I bought this on TodayTix they were running a sale literally got it this morning they were doing a Tuesday matinee I wasn't even gonna see this but I'm so glad I did and uh if you are in London catch it before it closes cause honestly it was it was so much better than I was expecting and I wish I wish I'd seen it earlier
